approval.note: An agent pulled the facts from the spec. The analyst approved them with four questions left open (at the bottom). The generator never turns a question into a test. It only lists it.

source.quote: The Delivery Fee is the fee the restaurant advertises — Free means $0.00.
The Service Fee is a flat $1.50 per order.
Total = Subtotal − discount + Delivery Fee + Service Fee
20% OFF orders over $25 takes 20 % off the subtotal once it passes $25, and the discount shows as its own line.
LEARN10 takes 10 % off the food subtotal. Delivery and service fees are never discounted.
The discount is rounded to the nearest cent, halves up: 10 % of $12.95 is $1.30.

Codes are not case-sensitive: learn10 works too. An unknown code says This code is not valid and gives no discount. One code per order. Applying it again does not add a second discount. Remove takes it off.

decisionTables.name: Discounts and minimum order
decisionTables.note: Conditions: 20% discount applies (yes/no) × LEARN10 applied (yes/no) × minimum order (none/met/not met) = 12 combinations.

data.note: Test data, not rules: prices and fees from the restaurant cards and menus in the app (FD-01 and FD-03 show them, the spec does not list them), read on 5 Nov 2026. Base prices only: the newer build has no size option.

openQuestions.question: Does the 20% restaurant discount (over $25) stack with the code LEARN10? If so, in what order, and is the $25 boundary checked before or after the code discount?
openQuestions.why: Decision table: the spec gives no result for the combination "restaurant discount applies × LEARN10 applied".

openQuestions.question: Does the 20% discount also apply to an order of exactly $25.00? The text says "over $25" and "once it passes $25", so the card uses "more than $25".
openQuestions.why: This is the value exactly on the boundary. Also, $25.00 cannot be built from the Burger Palace menu, so there is no test on the boundary yet.

openQuestions.question: What do the offers "20% off your first order" (Koliba u Jána) and "Free dessert with orders over $30" (Mediterranean Delight) mean? The spec only defines "20% OFF orders over $25". A "first order" makes no sense without an account.
openQuestions.why: The app shows them on the cards, but there is no rule for them. The generator leaves these restaurants out of the price tests.

openQuestions.question: How is the 20% restaurant discount rounded? The spec gives the "halves up" rule only for LEARN10.
openQuestions.why: So for the 20% discount the generator only picks carts where the discount comes out in whole cents.
